+"""Timestamp and report checks. Run with: python tests/test_timestamps.py"""
+
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from app.report import render
+from app.timestamps import oldest, parse_ts
+
+
+def test_timestamp_ordering_uses_offsets():
+    assert parse_ts("2026-08-29T01:06:05Z") == parse_ts(
+        "2026-08-29T10:06:05+09:00"
+    )
+    assert oldest([
+        "2026-08-29T10:06:05+09:00",
+        "2026-08-29T00:00:00Z",
+    ]) == "2026-08-29T00:00:00Z"
+
+
+def test_report_keeps_oldest_raw_timestamp():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        path = Path(tmp) / "events.jsonl"
+        path.write_text(
+            '{"at": "2026-08-29T10:06:05+09:00", "kind": "later"}\n'
+            '{"at": "2026-08-29T00:30:00Z", "kind": "earlier"}\n',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        assert render(str(path)) == (
+            "2 events\noldest: 2026-08-29T00:30:00Z"
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_timestamp_ordering_uses_offsets()
+    test_report_keeps_oldest_raw_timestamp()
+    print("ok")
